Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vikram - 29 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Sonali - 57 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vikram stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Vikram: "What lovely weather!"

[Vikram laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Vikram: "I knew it!"

[Vikram jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Sonali (surprised): "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The hospital ward - Day

[Vikram is asleep in bed in the ward. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "So, here we are!"

[After a long illness Vikram passes away in his hospital bed.]

Sonali: "We have to be strong now."
